description: Permanently delete a single message from a channel or thread. To delete between 2 and 100 recent messages at once use discord_bulk_delete_messages. Returns a confirmation object with the deleted message and channel IDs. Bot permissions it may need: View Channel, Manage Messages. Destructive: the user is asked to approve the exact change before it runs.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel or thread that holds the message

reason.description: Audit log reason sent in the X-Audit-Log-Reason header (up to 512 characters)

name: discord_delete_message

channel_id.description: Discord snowflake ID as a numeric string

message_id.description: Discord snowflake ID as a numeric string
